meta.name: manage-channels
meta.description: Wire channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups. Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将频道连接到代理组并管理隔离级别
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理多个频道与代理组的映射关系
copy.tagline_en: Wire channels to agent groups and manage isolation levels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage mappings between channels and agent groups

howto.what: 它会引导你完成频道与 Agent 群的接线:询问平台 ID 和隔离方式,创建或复用接线;也能修改现有接线、添加频道群组,并展示当前配置总览。
howto.when: 在添加新频道后、初始设置期间,或单独想重新配置频道与 Agent 群组接线时触发。

say.text: 把 Telegram 群 A 接到 agent-1
say.note: 会询问平台 ID 和隔离方式,再完成接线

say.text: 给 WhatsApp 再加一个新群
say.note: 按隔离问题选好意图后注册新群

say.text: 把 Slack 频道从 agent-1 改接到 agent-2
say.note: 旧会话留在原群,新消息进新群

howto.what_en: It guides you through wiring messaging channels to agent groups: asks for the platform ID and isolation choice, then creates or reuses the wiring. It can also modify existing wirings, add channel groups, and show a configuration summary.
howto.when_en: Triggers after adding a channel, during initial setup, or standalone when you want to reconfigure channel-to-agent-group wiring.

say_en.text: Connect Telegram group A to agent-1
say_en.note: It will ask for the platform ID and isolation mode, then wire it.
Pick an isolation intent and it registers the new group.

say_en.text: Move the Slack channel from agent-1 to agent-2
say_en.note: Old sessions stay with the old group; new messages go to the new one.
